messages:
alex: Heads up — planning a small targeted backfill for tenant 'atlas' (agg-hours) for 2024-02-10T00:00 -> 2024-02-11T00:00. I want to use the reprocess API with an operator override so we can push this through priority routing without blocking live traffic. @tanvi @ross PTAL for quota / SLO concerns.

tanvi: Can you paste an estimate of slot-mins / cost? Last time a similar 1-day window was ~1200 slot-min. If we route to priority-lane we need to confirm reserved burst is available. Also the console should surface estimated cost before run. :thinking_face:

ross: Operator override makes me nervous — who can flip it? We need audit and an approval flow (2nd approver or scoped short-lived tokens). Also make sure the request accepts a checkpoint_id so we can resume.

alex: Agree on audit + approval. Proposal: keep API semantics but require a header `X-Operator-Auth` for override and write an audit entry to telemetry with operator, ticket id, and snapshot. Example request body we plan to accept:

```
{
  "tenant": "atlas",
  "start": "2024-02-10T00:00:00Z",
  "end": "2024-02-11T00:00:00Z",
  "mode": "targeted",
  "routing": "priority-lane",
  "checkpoint_id": "ckpt-20240210-1",
  "duration_ttl": 3600
}
```

The `duration_ttl` auto-unsets the override after X seconds so an operator token won't stay live forever.

maya: For console UX: show estimated slots and dollar cost in the modal with a checkbox "Requires operator approval" that creates an approval ticket and links back to the audit. Button text: `Run (Requires Operator Approval)`. Also include a dry-run button that returns estimates only.

eng-bot: Job 762134 enqueued by alex at 2024-02-12T15:45:12Z — state: queued.

tanvi: Operational note: if priority-lane is saturated fallback should not error out the job — fallback flow should write the payload to cold S3 ingestion and schedule a retry window with exponential backoff. Failing loudly will cause alert fatigue.

ross: Add a preflight dry-run endpoint that returns: estimated slot-mins, cost, and SLO risk score. Something like `POST /reprocess/dryrun` -> `{ estimate: { slots: 1200, cost_usd: 23.4 }, slo_risk: "low" }`. Console should block runs if slo_risk == "high" unless operator override is present.

alex: Sounds good. I'll draft a PR to add `X-Operator-Auth`, the `/reprocess/dryrun` route, and console modal changes. Will gate behind feature flag `reprocess-operator-override` and canary to infra team first. Timeline: PR tomorrow AM, canary EOW. :thumbsup: 

maya: +1. Please include runbook steps in PR description.

alex: Quick runbook snippet to include in the PR description:
- Verify reserved burst capacity in Console -> Deployments > Capacity
- Trigger dry-run and confirm estimates
- Create approval ticket (Console modal links to /internal/approvals)
- Run reprocess via CLI `./replay --tenant atlas --start 2024-02-10T00:00 --end 2024-02-11T00:00 --checkpoint ckpt-20240210-1` or POST to `/reprocess` with `X-Operator-Auth` header
- Monitor job at `/jobs/762134` and watch SLO dashboards for tail latencies

ross: Also ensure quota controller pre-charges or reserves estimated cost so we don't spike billing unexpectedly.

alex: Noted — will add a reserve step in the dry-run -> reservation flow. Thanks everyone, I'll post the PR link when ready.
